description_for_human: Model geopolitical escalation, chokepoint risk, nuclear deterrence and Monte Carlo risk — free, open-source, no login.
description_for_model: Deterministic Complex Adaptive Systems engine for geopolitical risk. Call /api/simulate with {base_escalation, triggers, nuclear_deterrence, aggression} to evolve one step, /api/monte-carlo for N stochastic runs with p10/p50/p90, /api/belief for Dempster-Shafer fusion + Hawk/Dove evolution, /api/scenarios for the pre-built crisis library. Values are research illustrations, not forecasts.
